candidate.answer_text: No sampled indication, linked registry, or mechanism study was supplied, so I cannot determine what inspecting them would permit us to say. From model knowledge, gosuranemab is an investigational anti-tau antibody, but an FTD indication alone would not establish clinical efficacy or confirm its proposed mechanism in people with FTD. This is an unverified development-control response, not clinical advice.
